summary: An audio follower that moves other machines' parameters: it listens to its own input or to a sidechain and turns the level (envelope follower with Peak or RMS detector, attack, release, floor, ceiling and curve), the pitch (low and high note, a confidence threshold and a glide) or the hits (an onset detector that starts a pulse with a decay and a hold) into one control signal, written to up to 8 targets (any parameter of any machine) with their own depth, polarity, range and curve, smoothly and never as an undo step. The audio passes through unchanged. Use it for an auto-wah, sidechain ducking without a compressor, a filter that follows a melody, a flash on every hit or a gate that chops on a rhythm it hears.
use_for: Open, duck or bend any parameter from the audio: the level (envelope follower), the pitch or the hits of a track or a sidechain, up to 8 targets, with the audio passing through unchanged.

parameters.name: Listen to
parameters.description: What it listens to: the audio passing through (input 1) or the signal wired to the second input
parameters.how: Chooses whether the follower hears the audio passing through it or the machine wired to its second (sidechain) input; the audio passing through is never changed.
parameters.sound: Sidechain lets one track move another: a kick wired to the second input ducks the pad this machine sits on.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Envelope: the level. Pitch: the note it hears. Onset: a pulse at each hit
parameters.how: Chooses what the follower measures: the level, the pitch or the hits of the sound it listens to.
parameters.sound: Envelope opens and closes things with the loudness, Pitch makes a parameter follow the melody and Onset fires a pulse on every hit.

parameters.name: Detector
parameters.description: Peak: the highest sample. RMS: the average power, closer to loudness
parameters.how: Chooses between the peak level, which answers to every spike, and the RMS level, which averages the power and follows the loudness.
parameters.sound: Peak reacts to each drum hit sharply, while RMS moves smoothly with the body of the sound.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Time constant of the rise when the level goes up
parameters.how: Sets how fast the output rises when the sound gets louder, from 0.1 to 500 ms (the time to cover 63 % of a step).
parameters.sound: Short attacks catch every hit at once while long attacks let the control swell in slowly.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Time constant of the fall when the level goes down
parameters.how: Sets how fast the output falls when the sound gets quieter, from 1 ms to 5 s (the time to cover 63 % of a step).
parameters.sound: Short releases make the control flutter with the sound while long releases leave a slow tail after each hit.

parameters.name: Floor
parameters.description: The level that gives 0 % (anything quieter stays at 0 %)
parameters.how: Sets the level in dB, from -80 to 0, that maps to the bottom of the control signal.
parameters.sound: Raising the floor makes quiet noise and bleed count for nothing.

parameters.name: Ceiling
parameters.description: The level that gives 100 % (anything louder stays at 100 %)
parameters.how: Sets the level in dB, from -80 to 0, that maps to the top of the control signal; the floor and the ceiling are at least 1 dB apart.
parameters.sound: A low ceiling reaches full depth on soft playing while a high one keeps the control moving on loud peaks.

parameters.name: Curve
parameters.description: Bends the level to control mapping: + eases in (slow start), - eases out
parameters.how: Bends the straight line from floor to ceiling, from -100 % (fast start) to +100 % (slow start).
parameters.sound: Positive curves ignore the quiet parts and only react to the loud hits while negative curves open at the slightest sound.

parameters.name: Pitch range
parameters.description: The lowest and highest pitch it listens for: Voice 70 Hz to 1.1 kHz, Guitar 80 Hz to 1.2 kHz, Bass 38 to 400 Hz, Full 38 Hz to 2 kHz
parameters.how: Chooses the range of pitches the tracker searches; a narrower range answers sooner (Voice about 21 ms, Bass and Full about 40 ms of window).
parameters.sound: Pick the range of the instrument: the right one answers faster and makes fewer octave mistakes.

parameters.name: Low note
parameters.description: The MIDI note that gives 0 % (36 = C2)
parameters.how: Sets the note, from 0 to 127 (60 = C4, 36 = C2), at the bottom of the control signal.
parameters.sound: Notes under it keep the control at its lowest.

parameters.name: High note
parameters.description: The MIDI note that gives 100 % (84 = C6)
parameters.how: Sets the note, from 0 to 127 (60 = C4, 84 = C6), at the top of the control signal; it is at least one semitone above the low note.
parameters.sound: Notes over it keep the control at its highest; a narrow span makes small pitch moves large.

parameters.name: Confidence
parameters.description: How clear the pitch must be to count (under it the output holds)
parameters.how: Sets how periodic the sound must be, from 0 to 100 %, before its pitch is used; under it the output holds its last value.
parameters.sound: High values ignore noisy or breathy moments and hold the last note, low values follow almost anything.

parameters.name: Pitch glide
parameters.description: How slowly the output follows a change of pitch
parameters.how: Smooths the pitch with a time constant from 0 to 500 ms before it is mapped.
parameters.sound: A longer glide turns steps between notes into slides and hides small wobbles.

parameters.name: Sensitivity
parameters.description: How soft a hit may be and still fire a pulse
parameters.how: Sets the onset threshold: high values fire on soft hits and ghost notes, low values only on hard ones.
parameters.sound: Low sensitivity answers to the kick and snare only while high sensitivity also finds the hats and the soft hits.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: How long a pulse takes to fall (the time to lose 63 %)
parameters.how: Sets the fall of each pulse after its hold, from 5 ms to 2 s.
parameters.sound: Short decays make a flash on every hit and long decays leave the control open between hits.

parameters.name: Hold
parameters.description: How long a pulse stays at full before it falls
parameters.how: Keeps each pulse at its full value for 0 to 500 ms before the decay starts.
parameters.sound: Hold turns the pulse into a short gate that stays open for a set time.

parameters.name: Dynamic
parameters.description: On: a harder hit makes a taller pulse. Off: every hit is full
parameters.how: Switches whether the height of a pulse follows the level of the hit it came from.
parameters.sound: On keeps the playing's dynamics in the control while off makes every hit open it fully.

parameters.name: Smooth
parameters.description: Smooths the control signal with a time constant (0 = off)
parameters.how: Smooths the control signal after the mode has made it, with a time constant of 0 to 1000 ms.
parameters.sound: A little smoothing rounds off steps and jitter while a lot makes the control slow and gentle.

parameters.name: Invert
parameters.description: Turns the control signal upside down
parameters.how: Swaps the top and the bottom of the control signal before depth and bias.
parameters.sound: Inverted, a louder sound closes the target: ducking instead of opening.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: Scales the width of the control signal (0 to 100 %)
parameters.how: Scales how far the control swings before it reaches the target slots; at 0 % the targets stay where they are.
parameters.sound: Low depth gives subtle movement and high depth sweeps the whole span of each target.

parameters.name: Bias
parameters.description: Shifts the centre or floor of the control signal (-100 % to +100 %)
parameters.how: Offsets the control signal's floor in Unipolar range or its centre in Bipolar range before clamping to 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Positive bias keeps the target higher and negative bias pulls it lower.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Unipolar rises from Bias; Bipolar centres symmetrically around 50 % + Bias
parameters.how: Selects whether the control signal rises from its floor (Unipolar) or swings around the middle (Bipolar).
parameters.sound: Unipolar opens a target from its set value; Bipolar swings it both ways around that value.

parameters.name: Write glide
parameters.description: Least time a target takes to cross its whole range: no write moves further than this allows
parameters.how: Limits how fast each target parameter may move so writes never step faster than this full-range travel time.
parameters.sound: Short glides keep fast hits snappy and click-free while long glides turn sudden jumps into slow sweeps.
